How much is a used Sony WH-1000XM4 worth?

The WH-1000XM4 is one of the most traded noise-cancelling headphones. It is often confused with the XM3 and XM5, which have different prices.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The model name is printed inside the headband. The XM4 (2020) folds and looks very similar to the XM3. The XM5 (2022) has a smoother design and does not fold; the XM6 followed in 2025. Compare only with the same generation.

What decides the price

  • Earpads and headband: worn, flaking or dirty earpads lower the price. New pads are cheap and can raise it.
  • Case and cable: the hard case, the audio cable and the airplane adapter.
  • Battery: it should last many hours with noise cancelling on.
  • Colour: black and silver are the most common.
  • Fakes: cheap copies exist. Check the app pairing and the build quality.

Check before you buy

  • Connect them to the Sony app and check noise cancelling works on both sides.
  • Listen for crackling and test the touch controls.
  • Look at the hinges and headband for cracks.
  • Check the earpads for flaking.

Where it sells best

Light and easy to ship. Sells well on eBay, Vinted and local marketplaces. Clean the earpads and show the case in photos.

Questions

How much is a used Sony WH-1000XM4 worth?

It depends on condition of earpads and headband, case, colour and battery. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Sony WH-1000XM4" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

How much less is the XM4 worth than the XM5?

The XM4 sells below the XM5. The gap moves with new releases, so compare current listings of the same model.

Should I replace worn earpads before selling?

Often yes. Replacement pads are cheap and worn pads put buyers off more than their cost.
